name: sih26171-redaction-gate
description: SIH26171 — privacy-preserving browser agent with on-device visual perception and a one-way redaction gate.

scripts.build: npm run schema:gen && node extension/build.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: npm run schema:gen && node extension/build.mjs firefox
scripts.build:all: npm run schema:gen && node extension/build.mjs chrome && node extension/build.mjs firefox
scripts.test:gate: node extension/build.mjs chrome && node extension/build.mjs firefox && node scripts/test-gate.mjs
